decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint is a standard fitting close to the core pipeline business for utilities, so keeping it costs little even though recent website evidence is missing.
The ceiling and floor pipe bracket draws on existing fabrication and coating capabilities and serves current plant-builder and contractor customers.

The powder-coated public waste bin is distant from the core business, but it uses the coating equipment and sells to the municipalities the firm already serves, so it is worth keeping despite the uncertainty.
The waste bin with ashtray belongs to the same municipal street-furniture line as D and shares its production, so it stays unless that whole line is abandoned.
The outdoor ashtrays complete the street-furniture range built on powder coating, but they are exposed to weak demand and declining smoking, which keeps the withdrawal risk moderate.
